item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
What's new in 1.0.0

  • Initial commit
  • Flatten project structure and fix Xcode root paths
  • update docs
  • Implement ticket generation POC with clean architecture layers
  • Fix local Ollama connectivity in macOS app sandbox
  • Refactor app structure and wire generation to persisted templates
  • Add template dropdown to generate ticket view
  • Add copy-to-clipboard action for generated ticket output
  • Add AI settings module, app composition cleanup, and native macOS UI fixes
  • Polish UI: remove generate header and templates reload action
  • Harden Jira wiki generation flow and add unit test target
  • Integrate ticket preview flow and refine template generation UI
  • Update preview parsing and app composition wiring
  • Fix Jira wiki preview parsing and remove hardcoded section heuristics
  • Add separate Models screen with local and client model cards
  • Persist AI model selection and integrate Kiro local client routing
  • Add model-selection infrastructure and AI settings wiring
  • Improve AI model UX, provider availability checks, and ticket generation input behavior
  • Add per-template output format selection and persistence
  • Fix Codex delimited response extraction from echoed output
  • Integrate Claude client model with adapter-based AI settings wiring
  • Update project docs for current AI/model architecture and workflows
  • Apply pending ticket generation and template workflow updates
  • Apply bug fix update
  • Add targeted template and formatter test coverage
  • Add Jira settings feature with secure token UX
  • Implement Jira issue creation and project/work-domain configuration
  • Add Jira-backed template issue type dropdown and smarter issue type resolution
  • Commit non-priority updates across Jira settings and ticket generation
  • Add Jira priority support across issue creation flow
  • Add Jira attachment upload from create issue sheet
  • Implement Gemini cloud provider support and include pending Jira updates
  • Unify Jira connect flow and share session metadata across settings and issue creation
  • Fix argument order and missing returns in JiraIssueCreationUseCaseTests
  • Add My Tickets sidebar tab with JQL search and parent task display
  • Add copy ticket key button to My Tickets cards
  • Add Mentioned tab to My Tickets with segmented picker
  • Add ticket detail pane, mention snippets, and highlighted mentions
  • Refactor My Tickets: extract use cases, shared HTTP client, and test improvements
  • Add LLM-powered ticket summarization to My Tickets
  • Replace status transition popover with modal sheet dialog
  • Add attachment downloads and clickable bare URLs in ticket detail
  • Move settings into native macOS Settings window
  • Migrate AppShellViewModel and TemplateListViewModel to @Observable
  • Add legal documents module with first-run consent gate
  • Add eye toggle to reveal Jira token in settings
  • Merge branch 'fix/jira-token-visibility-toggle'
  • Add Quick Capture panel with global hotkey (closes #5)
  • Polish Draft-a-Ticket panel: header, editable draft, shared button
  • Merge branch 'feature/issue-5-quick-capture' (closes #5)
  • Integrate Polar licensing with blocking activation gate (closes #6)
  • Merge pull request #13 from Dalibaba/feature/issue-6-polar-licensing
  • Integrate Sparkle for in-app auto-updates (#9)
  • Add .gitignore and RELEASING.md
  • Rewrite RELEASING.md to cover both unsigned and signed paths
  • Add CI + manual-trigger release pipeline
  • Fix CI build failures: lower deployment target, rename notes README
  • Scrub 35 self-referential xcodeproj entries that broke Xcode 16.4
  • Work around Xcode 16.4 SPM resolver instability on CI
  • Move DerivedData out of the repo; watch if this unsticks SPM
  • Merge pull request #14 from Dalibaba/feature/issue-9-sparkle-autoupdate
  • Exclude tests, docs, workflows, scripts from app target bundle
  • Pin Sparkle tools version instead of parsing GitHub API
  • Clone release repo outside source tree
  • Defer release-repo clone until after the build
